rationale: Zero-ask approver regression check on 2e73a0f3 in the decomposition lens: clean, and the round-7 G2 fix is the most decomposition-positive change of the whole gate. The seven named Executor seam methods (SnapshotWorktreeTree, MaterializeStageCommit, PublishStageMarker, ReadStageMarker, ClearStageMarker, AdvanceBranchExpectedOld, ResetIndexToHead) give bead 6 an INTERNAL layered structure — gitutil primitives → named seams → complete-flow consumer — with the boundary sentence pinned (internal/complete calls only the seams, no new gitutil import). This materially improves the bead's single-panel reviewability: the machine can now be reviewed layer-against-layer inside one PR, which answers the residual size concern better than a split would have (the layers stay in one review where the primitive-vs-consumer seam bugs this gate kept finding remain visible). All three executor files were already in chunk 6 (verified in my own earlier-round sweeps, and re-checked rather than assumed this round); the diff introduces no new file names anywhere, no depends_on changed in any of the eight commits, and chunk/section parity holds in its final state. The twenty-leg count is consistent under the plan's labeling convention (twenty roman-numeral legs, viii carrying two pinned runs), and the three new legs map one-to-one onto the three elided-case windows the honest at-least-once contract creates — the proportionality property that has held since round 5. The at-least-once contract itself (withdrawing round-6's exactly-once in place, with per-operation replay proofs) is an honesty improvement in the plan's own currency and changes no seam, file, or dependency. Nothing implementation-corrupting; final judgment recorded below.

findings.title: Final decomposition judgment after eight rounds: ten beads sound; bead 6 acceptable-but-large, keep whole — now with internal layering that answers the size concern
findings.detail: Bead 6's final shape: gitutil primitives, seven named Executor seams (thin-wrapped, mock-stubbed, boundary pinned), both gates' snapshot legs, the write-ahead M/R/S/G/T flow in complete.go under an honest at-least-once replay contract, the ADR-0041 amendment, and twenty fixture legs. The ADR-0030 seam layer added this round is what a well-executed split would have produced as an artifact boundary — but delivered INSIDE one bead, so the layer-crossing review (where this gate found every substantive protocol bug: synthetic artifact deletion, phantom staged deletions, the over-read transaction atomicity, silent interval-edit loss, the unprovable exactly-once) happens in one panel instead of across two. The twenty legs remain proportionate: every leg added since round 4 pins exactly one mechanism decision (crash windows xii/xiii, CAS race xiv, trailer elision xv-xvii, the at-least-once elision windows xviii-xx, the viii refuse/converge split). Keep whole; no split would improve reviewability.
